load_glb_mesh: load a GLB mesh file into a PyTorch3D Meshes object with optional texture inclusion
save_mesh_to_glb: save a PyTorch3D Meshes object to a GLB file format with vertex textures
render_mesh_with_phong: render a PyTorch3D mesh using HardPhongShader with configurable camera position and lighting
test_glb_roundtrip: test loading a GLB mesh, saving it, and reloading to verify geometry and texture fidelity
create_texturesvertex_mesh: create a mesh with TexturesVertex colors and save it to a GLB file
